rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose term for a favorable or friendly attitude toward someone or something.

example.english: They have always shown goodwill toward the new colleague, so everyone gets along comfortably.

rows.note: Use this colloquial term when the goodwill means someone's kind intention or friendly gesture, especially in phrases like accepting or appreciating it.

example.english: Thanks for your goodwill, but I can carry these documents myself.

rows.note: Use this business term for the intangible value a company gains from its reputation, brand loyalty, and customer relationships.

example.english: This company relies on goodwill built up over many years, so customers are still willing to support it even after a price increase.
